notes.title: Solar Expanse Alpha update #1
notes.content:
Greetings our brave testers!

Thank you for your ongoing engagement in our game. We managed to address and fix some of the major issues, as well as add a little bit of extra content!

[b]Changelog:
[/b][list]
[*] added more trivia and respective artworks
[*] added a new contract "Asteroid impact"
[*] added several missing icons and texts
[*] rebalanced research time and availability
[*] unlocked cyclical missions at the start of the Expansion phase
[*] fixed the issue with halted productions and mining after loading a saved game
[*] fixed the issue with planned missions disappearing after loading a saved game
[*] fixed several issues with planning cyclical missions
[*] fixed several minor UI issues
[*] fixed several exceptions
[/list]

We hope that the changes will make your experience better! We still strongly recommend to complete feedback form (which can be accessed [b]<<[url=https://forms.gle/noYn2iZprMVVfDbYA]HERE[/url]>>[/b] or from the game's main menu by clicking "[b]SEND FEEDBACK[/b]"), and upload and share with us a video of your playthrough with commentary.

See you in space!
Solar Expanse Dev Team

notes.title: Asteroid pulling and new Spacecrafts!
notes.content:
Greetings Space Explorers!

[h2][b]Asteroid Pulling[/b][/h2]
As development skyrockets, we're focusing on adding more exciting features to help you reshape the stars to your liking. We proudly present Asteroid Pulling!

[previewyoutube=_OKiCxV2igc;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature will allow you to move asteroids to different orbits for simpler exploitation. 
You will need one to build a space elevator.
This way, you will be able to crash the asteroids into planets to bring necessary resources there, or help with terraformation! 
And who knows, maybe one day asteroid pulling will save humanity from some unexpected armageddon...
Anyway, who wouldn't like Earth to have another moon?

[h2][b]New Spacecrafts[/b][/h2]
What is more, we're making new space vessels and techs so you can traverse the stars!

[b]Atlas[/b]
What a beast! There's no weight this big boy cannot push, and it can even put small asteroids right where you need them! Powered by many fusion engines, it provides the highest power in the game (second only to Interstellar Ship)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/10a077078faa58be8fd672a89374507a65d01acd.png[/img]

[b]Prometheus[/b]
Brand new Nuclear Thermal Rocket which can take you to Mars in no time! Inspired by NASA's Design Reference Architecture 5.0, has been brought to life by our team! Outstanding cargo capacity, impressive exhaust velocity, and amazing dV are all that you need to reach as far as Jupiter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/6b47f0a0d39860930be9522b0fc3e95e0fcb002b.png[/img]

[b]Join our community on Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/m8zqqw94Rn]here[/url]![/b] 

See you in the outer space!
Solar Expanse Dev Team

notes.title: Progress update: Colonization & Interstellar Ship
notes.content:
Greetings Space explorers!

In case you're wondering how our work is proceeding - we keep doing whatever rocket science necessary to launch our game to the next level!

[b]Colonization[/b]

We keep expanding the ways to colonize other planets and make them habitable. With new systems, come new challenges, and we keep adding to the complexity of the issue by introducing human-operated facilities and energy supply systems, along with new buildings, resources and research to help achieve this task.

[previewyoutube=bUMFhq-y0vg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Interstellar Ship
[/b]
We’re sure you’re wondering about expanding to other planetary systems beyond our good old Solar System. As this is a huge milestone for civilization, building a spacecraft capable of transporting entire populations to places untouched by human foot is going to be one of our final tasks in space conquest. And once we’re able to do that… Who knows what may come next?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/11aa0123d89a2447f5e4eff5b8f396775ea13cb3.jpg[/img]
There's much more to come in the following months, so keep an eye on the sky, maybe you'll see a shooting star carrying more news!

Solar Expanse Dev Team

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE: New features and demo
notes.content:
[b]Space Explorers! We’re coming back to you with a bunch of exciting news! New rocket division, improved mission planning, asteroids, and DEMO! [/b]

[b]Space Exploration[/b] 

You’re not flying there blind! We’ve added new functions of exploration and discovery, which will give you information about what you can find on a chosen object. While it is not as accurate as sending a probe, the cost is significantly lower. At this point, you may ask: Why would I need resources on a different object?

[b]Launch Vehicles and Spacecrafts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/031c986d244184746f28a7bbb90362760dc0b77a.jpg[/img]
To experience as realistic space travels as possible, we have introduced the division of our rockets into: 
[list]
[*] Spacecrafts (that travel through space, obviously).
[*] Launch Vehicles (that just deliver stuff to orbit). It can be a rocket, but also a spin launch system or electric catapult too. Or in the future - a space elevator.
[/list]  
Now you can adjust the cargo load and fuel necessary for your missions more efficiently, and be well prepared for any kind of space voyage!

[b]Porkchop plot and updated mission planning panel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/63058f5015df2b20fea27e63131f92e3b1744b03.jpg[/img]
Speaking of missions - planning is now more detailed than ever before. It has been divided into convenient and intuitive sections to ensure easy setup. Moreover, we added a porkchop plot! This chart, used in actual space mission planning, will help you to choose a perfect launch window for your flight. The Axis represents the departure and arrival date, while the color represents the cost. Green line represents the Orbital Transfer Trajectory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/d0ed6f5a5c8e21a9ed302cae7246b33601ff3763.jpg[/img]
Don’t worry if you don’t get it - at the beginning, we didn’t either. Just click “Optimal” and the game will do the rest.

[b]FINAL DEMO RELEASE[/b]
We are extremely excited to announce that you will soon be able to experience our game yourselves, as a [b]demo version is finally coming in February 2024[/b]! Stay tuned!

See you in space,
SolEx dev team @ Jutsu Games

notes.title: Closed tests sign-up
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings space enthusiasts![/b][/h3]
The last couple months might have been quiet but I can promise you, we’ve been busy behind the scenes, and are coming with some news.

[h2]Limited tests sign up[/h2]
First of, and likely of most interest to you, we’re opening up our [b]playtest sign up[/b] form! Fill it out, answer a couple questions, and we’ll be sure to notify you when the time comes.
If that’s all you’re interested in, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1vh8ll5YdQBGBLGLM0rkQhjJMVw5EZ3Jlj3SUM9m8p3k/edit]FOLLOW THIS LINK [/url] to sign-up and receive an access to the early build of our game in the future. 

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1vh8ll5YdQBGBLGLM0rkQhjJMVw5EZ3Jlj3SUM9m8p3k][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/e53e55801f976fedd7af40ec24768a980eae7be2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]In other news[/h2]

We’ve been busy. Our team has grown and we’re hard at work making the game better. You might remember our last announcement where we showed off mission planning. While it’s not completely unrecognizable, we’ve iterated and improved it accounting for some design changes in the project. We might be doing rocket science here to make sure everything checks out, but we don’t want our user experience to be similar to the sometimes confusing calculations we deal with! Sadly there’s not much to show yet so you’ll have to go off my word. 

We’ve also worked hard on the various contracts and jobs you will encounter during your playthrough. You’ll start off with simple tasks of flying to the Moon and beyond, and advance into interesting challenges of paving the road to stars through the construction of bases and propellant depots out in space.The early contracts will organically and non-intrusively teach you how to play, while the mid- and late-game contracts will leave plenty of freedom in how to approach your objectives. Make sure to plan out your expansion well so you can quickly respond to various tasks!


By the way, here are a couple of space-exploration games that we would recommend checking:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846030/V_Rings_of_Saturn/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/758690/Occupy_Mars_The_Game/

notes.title: Development Update: Mission Planning
notes.content:
Space explorers!
This time we will talk about the basic interactions within the game

[h3]Plan Mission[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/ec0e98a2952614b8f25521d058be06b69617c1ad.png[/img]

Planning missions is a very important part of our game. In this window, you will be able to: 
[list]
[*] Decide which rocket is going to be sent,
[*] Type and ammount of cargo (resources, modules, telesopes, probes etc.),
[*] Select randevous type, for example: flyby, land or impact. 
[*] Decide whether rocket start will be optimal or unoptimal, which means less or more fuel will be needed and spacecraft will reach its destination slower/faster,
[*] Pick unique name for your mission for easier navigation through missions list.
[*] Check start & arrival date and mission length.
[/list]

[h3]Find Object[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/b8549996a204310df55683a508fe669c085909fe.png[/img]
Find Object panel is another singificant element of gameplay in Solar Expanse. In this panel, you will switch between objects and its moons, search for destinations for your missons, but it will also serve as a tool to easily track down any spacecraft that is situated on low/high orbit of its parent object or any spacecraft that has been succesively launched. Sorting objects by type (terrestrial planets, gas giants, artificial satellites, asteroid belt objects etc.) will help you find these objects faster and more efficiently.

[h3]Graphic Improvements[/h3]
There is a number of other visual improvements that we are developing at the moment - layers, lines, labels, planets textures, clouds, spacecraft models, lights, rocket fumes... more will come :) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/5fcca362032253e05bd7beeb3ff0376631b6c7bb.png[/img]

Best,
SolEx dev team @ Jutsu Games

notes.title: Development Update: Orbital Transfers
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings astronauts & colonizers![/h3]
The time has come to present you Solar Expanse major development update!
Thank you all for your patience - we are doing some literal Rocket Science here!

[h3]Flights Trajectories[/h3]
Our primary goal is to create a realistic game about space travels. Therefore we are working hard to simulate the orbital transfers. Here you can see a classic Hohmann transfer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/1344d0a4d95ce498a70dd989913d3d6b556f7d6b.png[/img]

Later in the game, for a much larger fuel and technological cost, you will be able to expedite the transfers too

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38448667/f27b35f4dc0d2cf5b82b4b713ab57c0f2c117913.png[/img]


How do you feel about that? Let us know in the comments! 
[b]
Best,
SolEx dev team @ Jutsu Games[/b]
